$comment: Project-local MCP aliases. The actual server endpoints are configured per-environment (harness or Claude Agent SDK). This file is a documentation contract — the orchestrator resolves MCP tool names through CANVA_MCP_PREFIX and HIGHSSFIELD_MCP_PREFIX in .env so the same code works in both contexts.

canva.$description: Canva MCP. Required tools: generate-design, generate-design-structured, create-design-from-candidate, start-editing-transaction, perform-editing-operations, commit-editing-transaction, cancel-editing-transaction, upload-asset-from-url, get-design, get-design-pages, get-design-content, get-design-thumbnail, get-assets, help.

highssfield.$description: Higgsfield (a.k.a. highssfield) MCP. Required tools: generate_image, job_display, show_medias, show_generations, media_upload, media_confirm, models_explore, balance, list_workspaces, select_workspace.
